_readme: Every line of spoken Irish in Chapter 1, for the TTS bake-off
(ABAIR vs ElevenLabs vs gemini-3-flash — see docs/ABAIR.md for the
licensing constraints; ABAIR output must NOT be bundled before written
consent). A provider script should emit one clip per line into this
directory, named <slug>.mp3 (or .m4a/.wav/.caf). The app checks this
directory first for every sound affordance and hides the ear for any
line that has no clip, so partial drops are fine.
Slug rule (mirrors SpeechService.slug): lowercase; fada vowels double
(á→aa é→ee í→ii ó→oo ú→uu); any other non-letter is a word break;

speakers.daire: male, unhurried, west-of-Ireland (Conamara) — the stone-carver; also the neutral voice for single words
speakers.brid: young female, quick and bright — Dáire's daughter
